Bryce Merkl Sasaki.bio: Bryce Merkl Sasaki is the Blog Editor for the Knowledge Graph Conference. He has nine years of experience working in the graph technology industry and loves the potential of connected data. When he's not traveling, Bryce is based in the San Francisco Bay Area

François Scharffe & Thomas Deely.bio: François Scharffe & Thomas Deely are the co-founders of the Knowledge Graph Conference.

Paco Nathan.bio: Paco Nathan is an evil mad scientist who works as a graph data scientist during the day.

Paige Barrett.bio: Paige Barrett is the CMO of the Knowledge Graph Conference.

Poya Osgouei.bio: Poya Osoguei is the founder and CEO of EventSponsors.co, helping organizations such as the Knowledge Graph Conference with sponsorships. Poya also hosts Uncharted Podcast, featuring inspiring business leaders. Born in Tehran, Iran, he immigrated to the U.S. as a teenager and now lives in the San Francisco Bay Area.

The metaphacts Team.bio: metaphacts is a Germany-based company delivering metaphactory – a platform that empowers customers to accelerate their knowledge graph journey and drive knowledge democratization, improve data literacy, and reach smarter business decisions with data. The metaphacts team offers unmatched experience and know-how around enterprise knowledge graphs for our clients across a broad range of industries and sectors.
